description.en: The glowing engines of the universe — how stars are born, live, and die, and why they come in so many colors and sizes.
description.hr: Uzareni motori svemira — kako se zvijezde radjaju, zive i umiru, i zasto dolaze u toliko boja i velicina.

back.en: A giant ball of glowing plasma held together by its own gravity, fusing lighter elements into heavier ones and releasing light and heat.
back.hr: Ogromna kugla uzarene plazme koju drzi vlastita gravitacija, spajajuci lakse elemente u teze i oslobadjajuci svjetlost i toplinu.

back.en: A giant cloud of gas and dust in space. Many are stellar nurseries, where gravity pulls material together to ignite new stars.
back.hr: Ogroman oblak plina i prasine u svemiru. Mnoge su 'rodilista zvijezda', gdje gravitacija spaja materijal da zapali nove zvijezde.

media.image_hint: NASA/Hubble ili JWST snimak Orionove maglice. Trazi 'Orion Nebula' na images.nasa.gov. Provjeri licencu (Hubble/JWST cesto NASA/ESA — provjeri ESA dio).

front.en: Why do stars have different colors?

back.en: Color reveals temperature. Blue stars are the hottest, red the coolest — the opposite of what taps and faucets taught you.
back.hr: Boja otkriva temperaturu. Plave zvijezde su najtoplije, crvene najhladnije — suprotno od onog sto te naucila slavina.

back.en: A dying star that has swollen enormously as it runs low on fuel. Our Sun will become one, swallowing the inner planets.
back.hr: Umiruca zvijezda koja se ogromno napuhala kako joj ponestaje goriva. Nase Sunce ce postati crveni div i progutati unutrasnje planete.

front.en: What is the closest star to our Sun?
front.hr: Koja je najbliza zvijezda nasem Suncu?

back.en: Proxima Centauri, about 4.2 light-years away. Even at the speed of light, getting there would take over four years.
back.hr: Proksima Kentauri, oko 4,2 svjetlosne godine daleko. Cak i brzinom svjetlosti, put bi trajao preko cetiri godine.

back.en: The explosive death of a massive star. For a few weeks it can outshine an entire galaxy, forging gold, silver and iron.
back.hr: Eksplozivna smrt masivne zvijezde. Nekoliko sedmica moze zasjeniti cijelu galaksiju, kujuci zlato, srebro i zeljezo.

explanation.en: The atoms in your body were forged inside stars and scattered by supernovae.
explanation.hr: Atomi u tvom tijelu iskovani su unutar zvijezda i rasuti supernovama.

media.image_hint: NASA snimak Rakove maglice (Crab Nebula) — ostatak supernove. Trazi 'Crab Nebula' na images.nasa.gov. Provjeri licencu.

back.en: The ultra-dense core left after a supernova. A teaspoon of it would weigh billions of tonnes on Earth.
back.hr: Ultra-gusta jezgra koja ostaje nakon supernove. Kasicica te materije tezila bi milijarde tona na Zemlji.

back.en: From a few million years for giants to trillions for the smallest. Small red dwarfs will outlive the current age of the universe many times over.
back.hr: Od nekoliko miliona godina za divove do biliona za najmanje. Mali crveni patuljci nadzivjet ce sadasnju starost svemira mnogo puta.

back.en: The largest known, like Stephenson 2-18, could swallow Saturn's orbit if placed where our Sun is. Our Sun is a speck beside it.
back.hr: Najvece poznate, poput Stephenson 2-18, progutale bi Saturnovu orbitu da su na mjestu naseg Sunca. Nase Sunce je mrvica pored nje.

back.en: A pattern we see from Earth — but the stars in it usually lie at wildly different distances and aren't neighbors at all.
back.hr: Uzorak koji vidimo sa Zemlje — ali zvijezde u njemu obicno leze na jako razlicitim udaljenostima i uopce nisu susjedi.

front.en: Are we really made of stardust?
front.hr: Jesmo li stvarno napravljeni od zvjezdane prasine?

back.en: Yes, literally. Nearly every atom in you heavier than hydrogen was forged inside a star and released when it died.
back.hr: Da, doslovno. Gotovo svaki atom u tebi tezi od vodika iskovan je unutar zvijezde i oslobodjen kad je umrla.

front.en: What is the brightest star in our night sky?
front.hr: Koja je najsjajnija zvijezda na nasem nocnom nebu?

back.en: Sirius, in Canis Major. It looks so bright partly because it's genuinely luminous and partly because it's close — just 8.6 light-years away.
back.hr: Sirijus, u Velikom psu. Izgleda tako sjajno dijelom jer je stvarno svijetao, a dijelom jer je blizu — samo 8,6 svjetlosnih godina daleko.

back.en: The small, dense, slowly cooling core left when a Sun-like star dies. It quietly fades over billions of years.
back.hr: Mala, gusta, polako hladeca jezgra koja ostaje kad umre zvijezda poput Sunca. Tiho blijedi kroz milijarde godina.
